runtimeDefects.cause: dispose removed listeners without clearing heldKeys or canceling capture
runtimeDefects.fix: idempotent dispose invokes existing blur cleanup before detaching

runtimeDefects.cause: Harness lacked a favicon declaration; Chrome requested missing /favicon.ico
runtimeDefects.fix: Explicit empty data favicon; console errors now include source URLs
runtimeDefects.scope: Harness only; no game payload changes

diagnosticCorrections: Initial horizontal mouse probe had no observed yaw delta. A stepped retry captured delivered movementX events and actual yaw change; physical hardware and recenter behavior remain uncertified.
Initial tab/minimize checks expected hidden while Playwright emulated focus. Disabling focus emulation produced actual blur and verified release; visibility stayed visible.
Initial block audio attempts targeted the player support block and later ran while falling. Repaired only the disposable platform and gated on actual onGround/Y before successful checks.

Master mute initially asserted masterGain=0. The game suppresses source playback at zero configured volume, leaving graph masterGain=1. Captured peak=0 and zero source starts validate silence; restore produced nonzero samples.
Long PTY command hit the macOS canonical input buffer; cleared the unsubmitted line and used short calls to helper files.
Interactive ESM cached an earlier helper version; used a versioned helper import after adding exports.
LAN peers menu remains open after guest connects; driver must navigate host menus back to gameplay rather than wait for automatic closure.
A disconnected guest returns to JoinMultiplayerScreen. Native invitations are handled from TitleScreen; navigate Back before sending the reconnect invite.
Initial guest username field edit did not persist. Tests bind to the actual generated native player name rather than claiming the requested name was applied.

A reconnect reached a real remote world and a second open gameplay channel, but the combined assertion stopped while trying to close the host lobby with Escape. The peers screen requires its Back button; forced channel-loss cleanup passed on that second connection.
An early startup wait used an undeclared global and emitted one captured page ReferenceError; predicates now use optional window properties.
Final desktop helper passes 18/18 on the repaired runtime; synthetic zero-delta recenter still fails and is explicitly unverified.
Initial process cleanup search matched its own shell command; executable-prefix filtering confirmed zero remaining task Chrome main processes.
